title: Pagayo - The Order-First Commerce Platform
description: Build and scale modern webshops, hotels, and POS systems on one powerful multi-tenant platform.

hero.headline: One Platform. All Channels.
hero.subheadline: Webshop, POS, WhatsApp, TikTok — all orders flow through one unified system. No more juggling multiple platforms.

features.title: Order-First Architecture
features.description: One unified order model for web, POS, social, and more. No channel silos.

features.title: Multi-Tenant by Design
features.description: Each business gets their own isolated database schema. Enterprise-grade security.

features.title: Edge-Native Performance
features.description: Deployed on Cloudflare's global network. Sub-50ms response times worldwide.

features.title: API-First
features.description: Everything is an API. Integrate with any system, build custom frontends.

features.title: Payments Built-In
features.description: Bunq, Stripe, and more. Automated reconciliation and payouts.

features.title: Real-Time Analytics
features.description: Live dashboards across all channels. Know what's selling, when.

cta.headline: Ready to Unify Your Commerce?
cta.description: Join businesses that have simplified their operations with Pagayo's order-first platform.
